summary.text: My-Linh Thai is a Democratic member of the Washington House of Representatives from District 41-Position 2, where she has served since January 2019, and she is on the November 3, 2026 general election ballot seeking re-election.
A pharmacist by training and a former Bellevue school board member, she is Deputy Majority Leader of the House Democratic Caucus.

paragraphs.text: My-Linh Thai immigrated to Washington state at age 15 as a Vietnamese refugee with her family; Ballotpedia gives the year of arrival as 1983.
She graduated from Federal Way High School and the University of Washington School of Pharmacy.
Her professional experience includes working as a staff pharmacist at ShopKo and as the manager of a medical practice.
Thai volunteered as a PTSA parent and received the Washington State PTA Outstanding Advocate Award in 2013.

She served on the Bellevue School District school board from 2013 to 2018, and in 2017 her fellow board directors elected her Vice President of the Washington State School Board Directors Association.
She took office in the Washington House on January 14, 2019.
The House Democrats' biography lists her as Deputy Majority Leader and as a member of the Appropriations, Civil Rights & Judiciary, Health Care & Wellness and Rules committees.
